newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rothschild buys 13 pct of Ballarat.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rothschild buys 13 pct of Ballarat.

text.p: Ballarat Goldfields NL said on Friday it would place 37.5 million or 13 percent of its shares to merchant bank Rothschild Australia Ltd at eight cents per share.
Ballarat also said it would form a joint venture with Rothschild for the Ballarat Gold project.
"In addition Ballarat Goldfields will sell a substantial portion of its exploration information to a Rothschild group company," Ballarat said.
The information sold would continue to be available to the joint venture and Ballarat would forego future income tax deductions associated with the previous exploration expenditure.
"Rothschild through a group company and Ballarat Goldfields will enter into a joint venture to further explore and mine the Ballarat project. Rothschild would commit to spend A$5.8 million."
Ballarat's ultimate share of the joint venture would not be any less than 75 percent.
Ballarat Goldfields would be the operator and manager of the Victorian project on behalf of the joint venture.
Ballarat's shares were down 0.6 of a cent at 7.9 cents at 12.00 p.m. (0100 GMT).
